data.title: Cops transferred after venue raid
data.description: Five senior police at Chana Songkhram station have been transferred to inactive posts pending an investigation after a special task force raided an unlicensed entertainment venue on Khao San Road and found several alleged violations.

data.title: Labour minister calls on voters to cast ballots in SSB election
data.description: Labour Minister Julapun Amornvivat has urged insured workers and employers to participate in today’s Social Security Board (SSB) election, which will determine the future direction of an agency managing a fund worth nearly 3 trillion baht.

data.title: PM warns of rain as cleanup begins
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul urged authorities to accelerate post-flood recovery efforts and warned 14 southern provinces to prepare for another round of heavy rainfall.

data.title: Flood victims turning to loan sharks
data.description: The opposition Democrat Party has called for better access to financial assistance for flood victims in Bangkok, saying unclear and delayed relief measures have forced some affected traders to turn to loan sharks to keep their businesses afloat.

data.title: Govt figures unfazed by debate plan
data.description: Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas on Saturday brushed aside concerns after being named in the planned no-confidence debate, saying he had done nothing wrong as an official.

data.title: Hurricane Simon strengthens to category 4 as it nears western Mexico
data.description: PUERTO VALLARTA (MEXICO) - Hurricane Simon strengthened into a powerful Category 4 storm as it swept toward Mexico's west coast, where it was expected to make landfall late Saturday or early Sunday.

data.title: US lethal injection survivor returns to prison
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - Convicted murderer Christa Pike, who survived a botched execution attempt in the US state of Tennessee last week, has been discharged from hospital and returned to prison, her lawyers said Saturday.

data.title: Exam fraud file 'met NACC deadline', police chief says
data.description: Police submitted their investigation file on fraud in local government recruitment examinations to the National Anti-Corruption Commission (NACC) within the required 30-day deadline, says national police chief Pol Gen Samran Nualma.

data.title: Wrong-way driver receives suspended term
data.description: The Northern Bangkok District Court on Friday sentenced a 77-year-old motorist to one month in jail, suspended for two years, for driving against traffic on Vibhavadi Rangsit Road.

data.title: Plans for common ticketing system speed up
data.description: The Transport Ministry is accelerating plans to introduce a common ticketing system for Bangkok's electric rail network on Jan 1, 2027, allowing passengers to change lines without paying a second entry fee and capping fares at 45 baht per trip.

data.title: King congratulates Nene Royal
data.description: His Majesty the King congratulated Rattikarn “Preaw” Amloy, known as “Nene Royal”, winner of America’s Got Talent 2026.

data.title: Public invited to join IMF-World Bank town hall
data.description: The government is inviting the public to follow the International Monetary Fund (IMF)-World Bank meetings online from Monday and submit questions during a "Town Hall” session.

data.title: Abbas postpones Palestinian legislative elections to September 2027
data.description: RAMALLAH (PALESTINIAN TERRITORIES) - Palestinian president Mahmoud Abbas on Saturday postponed legislative elections to September next year, official media said, confirming widespread speculation that they would be delayed once again.

data.title: Thousands join pro-Palestinian marches in several European cities
data.description: LONDON - Thousands of people on Saturday joined pro-Palestinian marches in London, Berlin and Dublin calling for an end to Israeli strikes on Gaza, three years after Hamas's October 7 attack.

data.title: Anutin orders NBTC to explain chairman's meeting notices
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has ordered the National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC) to explain why its chairman continues to convene board meetings despite a court ruling concerning his eligibility to hold office.

data.title: Thai PBS funding in spotlight
data.description: A proposal by the ruling Bhumjaithai Party (BJT) to amend laws governing four public bodies has sparked debate over their funding and accountability.

data.title: Ekanit on the double as ten-man Ratchaburi hit Sukhothai fox six
data.description: Ratchaburi were reduced to 10 men in the first half but still cruised to a 6-0 win over Sukhothai FC in the Thai League 1 on Friday night, with Ekanit Panya scoring twice in front of the home crowd.

data.title: Thai star Ratchanok rallies to reach Artic Open final
data.description: Ratchanok Intanon staged a fightback to book her berth in the women's singles final of the US$500,000 Arctic Open 2026 in Vantaa, Finland, on Saturday.

data.title: Spanish election campaign overshadowed by housing protests
data.description: DOS HERMANAS, Spain - Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez is aiming to pull off another unlikely comeback as he began campaigning on Saturday for a vote dominated by housing protests that have shaken the country.

data.title: Putin relays Iran’s view on peace deal to Trump
data.description: Kremlin says Russian leader discussed issue with Iranian counterpart this week

data.title: Suspects flee country after B37m robbery of Turk in Pattaya
data.description: Police are seeking help from Chinese authorities and Interpol to arrest five suspects who fled Thailand within hours after robbing a Turkish businessman of cryptocurrency, cash and valuables worth 37 million baht at his luxury home in Pattaya.

data.title: Trump decries ‘disgraceful’ Nobel Peace Prize pick
data.description: US President Donald Trump decried the “disgraceful” Nobel Peace Prize choice on Friday as leaving an “indelible stain” on Norway, arguing that the award should have gone to him.

data.title: Prachin Buri factory probed over e-waste, wastewater
data.description: A factory in Kabin Buri district of Prachin Buri has been found handling electronic waste transported from Chon Buri and discharging wastewater behind its premises, prompting authorities to prepare health checks for nearby residents.

data.title: Russian strikes kill 11 including 3 children, says Kyiv
data.description: KYIV - Russian strikes on the southeastern city of Zaporizhzhia on Saturday killed at least 11 people, including three children, according to regional authorities in Ukraine.

data.title: Exam-rigging suspects freed as investigators miss deadline
data.description: Three key suspects in the civil service exam-rigging scandal were released from prison on Friday after the National Anti-Corruption Commission (NACC) failed to complete the investigation that would have supported their prosecution.

data.title: Indian ‘cockroach’ leaders detained ahead of major protest
data.description: NEW DELHI - Indian police detained the head of the satirical Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) online movement on Saturday ahead of a major protest it called against the Election Commission, the party said.

data.title: 11 foreign suspects arrested in nominee crackdown
data.description: Authorities on Saturday launched the eighth phase of a crackdown on illegal foreign property ownership, raiding 17 locations at four luxury housing estates in Bangkok and arresting 11 suspects, including Chinese nationals, with assets worth more than 6 billion baht seized.

data.title: IMF-World Bank meetings open to online viewers
data.description: The government is inviting the public to follow the IMF-World Bank annual meetings online for free from Monday, encouraging viewers to submit questions during the “Civil Society Townhall”.

data.title: Thailand to showcase 3 finance initiatives at IMF-World Bank meetings on Oct 12–18
data.description: Thailand will present Paotang and Nok Krasip AI in Bangkok, showing how digital tools can help small traders manage businesses and access finance

data.title: Gaza ceasefire promises mostly unfulfilled
data.description: JERUSALEM - One year after US President Donald Trump declared the war in Gaza to be over, few of the long-term promises of the ceasefire have come to fruition.

data.title: Trump hails deal with Russia to release diesel
data.description: WASHINGTON - US President Donald Trump said on Friday that he had secured Russia’s agreement for a major release of diesel, as he eased war sanctions on Moscow in a push to lower energy costs ahead of midterm elections.
